supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Wide lateral extension beyond the outer corners of the eyes

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between light, mottled muzzle area and darker dark-grey/black periocular and cheek regions

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive mottled depigmentation and dark freckling across the muzzle skin; yellow-colored organic matter visible in open mouth
